summary: Project Colors feature tested end-to-end. Backend 11/11 pytest pass (PUT valid color persists, 5 invalid formats -> 422, POST w/o color auto-assigns hex, POST with color persists, POST invalid -> 422). Frontend: /settings/projects cards show colored top bar + border tint + badge for all 9 projects (incl. those without saved color); create dialog has picker w/ 12 swatches + custom input and pre-selects next palette color; created TEST_UI_Color with #6366F1 -> card colored; edit -> 10B981 -> bar/badge/border update after save; custom input #123abc -> applied. BranchSelector dropdown (project-option-*) shows color dots; Reports > لوحة المؤسسة: 10 project-stats cards with colored bar + dashboard-project-badge, inventory chart bars filled per-project; Reports > سجل التحويلات: log-from/to badges colored, log-project-select options have dots. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow on page or dialog. Test project hard-deleted after test.

ui_bugs.issue: Color collision: 'صالون الأناقة' (index 1, saved #EC4899) and 'مشروع رابع تجريبي' (index 3, no saved color -> palette[3] = #EC4899) both render pink everywhere (cards, filters, transfers log). Defaults are index-based and ignore colors already explicitly chosen, so projects are NOT guaranteed distinct.
dashboard-project-badge-{id} shows raw English activity_type ('restaurant', 'salon', 'delivery_company') instead of Arabic label (مطعم/صالون/شركة توصيل) like the project cards do

issues: Legend shows a single blue 'قيمة المخزون' swatch while bars are per-project colored - legend misleading
Page title 'إدارة المشاريع' and subtitle nearly invisible (low contrast) on dark background; cards render white on dark page

action_items: Fix default color collisions: persist colors for existing projects via one-time idempotent migration choosing the first palette color not already used in tenant (also make POST auto-assign pick an unused color instead of count % 12, which collides after deletes). Frontend fallback should also skip colors already used.
Index-based fallback depends on the projects list visible to the current user (restricted project_admin sees a filtered list -> different colors than owner); persisting colors in DB solves this too.
EnterpriseDashboard: pass the Arabic activity label to ProjectColorBadge instead of p.activity_type
Optional: remove/adjust single-color legend on per-project inventory chart; improve title contrast on ProjectsSettings dark theme
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectColor.jsx projectColorOf: fallback PROJECT_PALETTE[idx % 12] is order/visibility dependent and collides with explicit colors
projects_routes.py create: count_documents % len(PALETTE) can duplicate existing colors after deletions or manual picks
ProjectsSettings openCreate preselects palette[projects.length] - same collision risk
